summary: First testing iteration for Saksham Learning. Backend API: 28/28 pytest cases passed. Frontend: home, navigation, shop+filters, blog list/detail, login, cart, checkout (mock), library, newsletter footer, admin dashboard with all sections, admin role guard — all functional.

minor.issue: Not exercised — depends on real Emergent OAuth session_id (cannot be tested without browser). Code path looks correct.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec (browsers may ignore credentials). Currently works because frontend uses Bearer fallback. Should set explicit origin (FRONTEND_URL) for cookie auth to be reliable cross-site.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking pay button on /checkout in mock mode, page navigates to /cart instead of /order-success. Order is correctly marked PAID in DB and worksheet appears in /library, but the dedicated success page is not shown. Worth confirming Checkout.jsx calls navigate('/order-success') after verify-payment.

action_items: Verify Checkout.jsx redirects to /order-success after successful mock payment (currently lands on /cart). Library does receive the worksheet, so backend is fine; only the post-pay UX redirect is questionable.
Optional: replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with explicit FRONTEND_URL when allow_credentials=True (best practice; not blocking since Bearer header fallback works).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 891 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, worksheets, orders, admin) for maintainability.
Razorpay signature verification path correctly uses hmac.compare_digest.
Mongo ObjectId is correctly excluded everywhere via projections.
Admin endpoints all behind require_admin dependency — verified non-admin gets 403.
Seed function is idempotent and re-syncs admin password if env changed.
All interactive UI elements observed don't all have data-testid attributes (e.g., login form uses generic input[type=email]); not blocking but recommended for stability.

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 448 worksheets, 6 testimonials, 3 blog posts on startup. Tests created TEST_ prefixed records and cleaned them up. One purchase was made for parent@test.com so /library now shows 1 worksheet (₹79 paid order) — left in place since it demonstrates working flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses Bearer-token auth via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Mock Razorpay flow: POST /api/orders/create returns is_mock=true, then POST /api/orders/verify with {order_id, mock:true} marks paid and adds to library. Library route on frontend is /library (not /my-library). Admin path is /admin/* with sub-sections (Dashboard, Worksheets, Orders, Users, Newsletter, Testimonials, Blog).
rca of the issue: Checkout->OrderSuccess: Backend verify-payment returns {status:'paid'}. If frontend Checkout.jsx is missing or has incorrect navigate('/order-success') call after successful verify, user is left on /cart (which itself shows empty cart since cart was cleared). Recommend main agent grep Checkout.jsx for navigate calls and verify it routes to /order-success on success, passing order_id as state/query.
